directions.name: Programmable Economic Relationships
directions.question: What should exist between an agreement and a transaction?

directions.name: Confidential & Bounded Coordination
directions.question: Can independent actors coordinate private economic intent without surrendering authority or revealing every input?

directions.name: Evidence, Judgment & Economic Understanding
directions.question: How should software move from observing reality to acting on an interpretation of it?

directions.name: Memory & Autonomous Agency
directions.question: How can autonomous systems improve from experience without silently surrendering decision authority to memory?

systems.name: OpenRails
systems.researchQuestion: What should exist between an agreement and a transaction?
systems.lineage: payment → intent → bounded authority → agreement + proof → persistent commercial relationship → verifiable settlement

systems.name: NOX ACCORD
systems.researchQuestion: Can independent parties coordinate over private economic inputs without revealing the inputs themselves or delegating the entire decision to a trusted intermediary?
systems.lineage: private inputs → confidential coordination → bounded outcome disclosure

systems.name: Concord
systems.researchQuestion: Can independent capital providers coordinate private terms inside one persistent economic relationship without erasing provider-level authority, exposure, and settlement lineage?
systems.lineage: confidential formation + persistent economic relationship → provider-specific exposure → verifiable settlement lineage

systems.name: RJP
systems.researchQuestion: How can a system move from raw onchain behavior to actionable trust without reducing complex evidence to an opaque reputation score?
systems.lineage: observation → reproducible evidence → bounded judgment → independent downstream action

systems.name: Noema
systems.researchQuestion: Can fragmented representations, claims, and evidence become an economic object software can inspect and reason about without losing the limits of the evidence underneath it?
systems.lineage: evidence + claims → verification → economic object → independent downstream reasoning

systems.name: Engram
systems.researchQuestion: When can we truthfully claim that an autonomous system learned from a previous execution?
systems.lineage: execution history → operational memory → policy-governed recall → changed action → observed outcome

systems.name: Thinking Reed
systems.researchQuestion: Can a human and AI work continuously across research and production without generated artifacts erasing uncertainty, dissent, authority, or the lineage of why something was built?
systems.lineage: thought → evidence → decision → bounded execution → artifact → observed reality → revision
